'''Eldrid Methin''' is a cook in the [[Sun Palace]] in [[Cairhien]].

==Activities==
Mistress [[Beldair]] bellows orders around the kitchen when [[Sashalle Anderly]] and [[Samitsu Tamagowa]] visit the kitchens in the Sun Palace. Eldrid is one of the cooks she gives orders to.

She spins terrible tales about what she has heard about the [[Dragon Reborn]] and the [[Asha'man]]. These include:
* That Rand tore half the palace apart with the One Power.
* He has killed tens of thousands of people and would kill you soon as look as you.
* That Rand killed [[Fedwin Morr]].
* That Asha'man can turn you to stone by looking at you.
* The Asha'man have glowing eyes and you can identify them by sight (she tells this excitedly to [[Karldin Manfor]], himself an Asha'man.

Mistress Beldair scolds her for talking so much about a subject she apparently hates to discuss.
